paragraphs: Yakeh. (Agur son of Yakeh, Proverbs ch. 30, v. 1).

Rabbi Chanina bar Yakeh: Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, at the end of 9:2. The consulted text reads Chanina bar Yakka. Hyman reports that in the Prague printing of the Pesikta, in the “Et Korbani” section, the name is Huna bar Yukan. The Shklov printing has Rabbi Chuna bar Yukan. The Arukh, under the entry קקבטין, reads Huna bar Yaki.

notes.text: The Prague and Shklov forms Yukan and the Arukh’s Yaki are retained as Hyman reports them. The Arukh entry label קקבטין is left in its supplied spelling.
